<p class="has-ast-global-color-5-color has-text-color eplus-wrapper wp-block-paragraph">​​The U.S. Army is seeking innovative autonomous sustainment solutions from eligible small and large businesses across the U.S. and allied foreign countries to strengthen resilient resupply in contested environments through the G-TEAD USARPAC ACE 27-01: Autonomous Sustainment powered by xTech. <h2 class=" wp-block-heading eplus-wrapper">DESCRIPTION</h2>



<p class="topic_text eplus-wrapper wp-block-paragraph"><p><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span aria-label="Rich text content control"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><a href="https://pit.army.mil/about/gtead/" data-wpel-link="external" target="_blank" rel="external noopener noreferrer" class="wpel-icon-right"><span data-contrast="none">The Global Tactical Edge Acquisition Directorate (G-TEAD)</span><span class="wpel-icon wpel-image wpel-icon-6"></span></a><span data-contrast="none">, in partnership with </span><a href="https://www.usarpac.army.mil/" data-wpel-link="external" target="_blank" rel="external noopener noreferrer" class="wpel-icon-right"><span data-contrast="none">U.S. Army Pacific</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">(USARPAC),</span><span class="wpel-icon wpel-image wpel-icon-6"></span></a><span data-contrast="none"> and powered by </span><a href="https://pit.army.mil/pathway/xtech/" data-wpel-link="external" target="_blank" rel="external noopener noreferrer" class="wpel-icon-right"><span data-contrast="none">Army FUZE xTech</span><span class="wpel-icon wpel-image wpel-icon-6"></span></a><span data-contrast="none">, is seeking </span><span data-contrast="auto">innovative autonomous sustainment solutions from eligible small and large businesses across the U.S. and allied foreign countries to strengthen resilient resupply for distributed operations in contested environments through</span><span data-contrast="none"> the G-TEAD USARPAC ACE 27-01: Autonomous Sustainment powered by xTech competition.</span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="none">​</span></span><span data-contrast="auto">This platform </span><span data-contrast="none">offers participants the opportunity to engage with the U.S. Department of War (DoW), earn prize money, and potentially receive a contract award or agreement. This initiative supports the U.S. Army’s broader effort to (1) identify and understand the spectrum of ‘world-class’ technologies being developed commercially that benefit the U.S. military; (2) integrate non-traditional innovators into the U.S. DoW Science and Technology (S&T) ecosystem; (3) provide expertise and feedback to accelerate, mature, transition, and scale technologies to support operational forces.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":254}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">The G-TEAD USARPAC ACE 27-01: Autonomous Sustainment powered by xTech will consist of three phases: </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":254}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">(1) ​</span><span data-contrast="auto">Application, including the following: </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559685":763,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335559991":403,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></p>
<ul>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">Four (4)-page white paper;</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">Required five (5)-minute video;</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">Self-certification of minimum requirements; and </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">Information on prior demonstrations with DoW or allied/partner nations </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
</ul>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">(2) Soldier exercise; and</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559685":763,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335559991":403,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">(3) Opportunity to submit follow-on contract proposal. </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559685":763,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335559991":403,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233279":true,"201341983":0,"335559685":720,"335559740":254}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">The U.S. Army intends to </span><b><span data-contrast="auto">award up to $1,500,000 in cash prizes</span></b><span data-contrast="auto"> throughout the competition. </span><b><span data-contrast="auto">Up to 15 finalists will be selected at the conclusion of the Part 1 evaluation period, awarded $25,000 each, </span></b><span data-contrast="auto">and provided the opportunity to participate in the Part 2 live Soldier exercise, anticipated to occur in November 2026.</span><b><span data-contrast="auto"> Finalists who also participate and have their technology successfully integrated in the exercise will receive an additional $25,000 each, following the event</span></b><span data-contrast="auto">. Following completion of the exercise, up to five (5) final winners will be selected to receive an additional cash prize of $150,000</span><b><span data-contrast="auto"> </span></b><span data-contrast="auto">each and may be considered for potential follow-on agreements and contracting opportunities. Additional details on prize structure can be found in Section VII </span><span data-contrast="none">of the RFI.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">At the Government’s discretion, participants that do not win a prize may also be considered for opportunities to demonstrate their capability.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">Any follow-on agreements are at the Government’s sole discretion and are subject to availability of funds and applicable laws and regulations. Nothing in this solicitation shall be construed as a commitment to issue a request for proposal (RFP) or award any contract or agreement. </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">Finalists and final winners must have a CAGE/NCAGE code to receive a cash prize and contract award. Firms may be requested to sign a Master Business Agreement (MBA) as a condition of eligibility for certain G-TEAD ACE follow-on opportunities. The execution of an MBA is not required for any other follow-on opportunities pursued outside of G-TEAD ACEs.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">A CAGE/NCAGE code is not required at the time of application; however, applicants that do not possess one (1) are strongly encouraged to initiate the registration process in advance if they intend to participate. </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">The </span><span data-contrast="none">G-TEAD USARPAC ACE 27-01: Autonomous Sustainment powered by xTech</span><span data-contrast="auto"> is conducted in accordance with 10 U.S.C. § 4025, which authorizes the use of prize competitions to stimulate innovation and identify promising technologies for national security applications. Requirements for competition under 10 U.S.C. § 3201 are satisfied upon completion of the challenge and use of prize authority. As such, this competition serves as a competitive down select mechanism that enables government organizations to engage with finalists and winners through a variety of follow-on acquisition pathways, including but not limited to:</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<ul>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">10 U.S.C. § 4114 – Selection of contractors for prototype projects</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">10 U.S.C. § 4022 – Prototype projects</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">10 U.S.C. § 4023 – Procurement for experimental purposes</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">10 U.S.C. § 4001 – Research and development</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">10 U.S.C. § 4021 – Other Transaction Authority (OTA)</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">10 U.S.C. § 3458 – Authority to acquire innovative commercial products and commercial services using general solicitation competitive procedures</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">15 U.S.C. § 3703 – Technology innovation partnerships</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">15 U.S.C. § 638 – SBIR and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) Programs</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240,"335572071":0,"335572072":0,"335572073":4278190080,"335572075":0,"335572076":0,"335572077":4278190080,"335572079":0,"335572080":0,"335572081":4278190080,"335572083":0,"335572084":0,"335572085":4278190080,"335572087":0,"335572088":0,"335572089":4278190080,"469789798":"nil","469789802":"nil","469789806":"nil","469789810":"nil","469789814":"nil"}"> </span></li>
</ul>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">Government organizations may consider leveraging these statutory authorities to pursue follow-on awards with companies identified through the xTech competition process. This approach supports rapid technology maturation, accelerates the transition of innovative capabilities to the field, and promotes collaboration with non-traditional and small business performers.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">While the authority of this program is 10 U.S.C. § 4025, the </span><span data-contrast="none">G-TEAD USARPAC ACE 27-01: Autonomous Sustainment powered by xTech</span><span data-contrast="auto"> may generate interest by other U.S. Army, DoW or U.S. Government (US G) organizations for a funding opportunity outside of this event. The interested organization may contact the participant to provide additional information or ask for a request for proposal in a separate solicitation. Finalists of the prize competition may have opportunities to submit a separate proposal for further development of their proposed technology solution based on the needs of the Army. The Army may use a contract mechanism of their choice and will notify the participants accordingly. </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><b><span data-contrast="auto">​</span></b><b><span data-contrast="auto">All</span></b><span data-contrast="none"> </span><b><span data-contrast="none">G-TEAD USARPAC ACE 27-01: Autonomous Sustainment powered by xTech</span></b><b><span data-contrast="auto"> submissions are treated as privileged information and contents may be disclosed to employees of the USG, allied nations, designated support contractors at the USG’s discretion for the purposes including, but not limited to, evaluation, program administration and support, potential inclusion in Army or DoW marketplaces, and consideration for potential follow-on opportunities. The Government will use reasonable efforts to protect proprietary information; however, participants are responsible for clearly identifying any proprietary or restricted information within their submissions.</span></b></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">The Army FUZE xTech Program intends to provide feedback from evaluators to participants during each part of the competition. The purpose of providing this feedback is to help accelerate the transition of the technology to a U.S. Army end-user by providing insight into the best applications for the technology, suggestions for product improvement for U.S. Army use and recommended next steps for development. However, the Government will not respond to inquiries regarding this feedback.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":254}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><b><span data-contrast="auto">​</span></b><b><span data-contrast="auto">Problem Statement</span></b></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":254}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">Sustainment of distributed forces across contested island chains presents significant challenges due to the vulnerability of traditional, manned logistics nodes in complex maritime, littoral, and land environments. Current intra-theater resupply operations depend on high-value, crewed assets that are at severe risk in contested waters, while the transfer and distribution of supplies on land impose heavy physical and cognitive burdens on personnel. To achieve resilient, multi-domain logistics, there is a critical need for integrated unmanned sustainment systems, including autonomous ground and air delivery systems for tactical resupply of dispersed formations. These systems must support a range of payloads and distances while being governed by advanced distribution management software and intuitive command and control architecture that synchronize autonomous swarms, automate supply routing, and significantly reduce human workload.</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">The Army is seeking to evaluate capabilities that demonstrate performance in one (1) of three (3) capability areas, and meet the following criteria for its capability area: </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<ul>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><b><span data-contrast="auto">​</span></b><b><span data-contrast="auto">Capability 1:</span></b><span data-contrast="auto"> Autonomous, Attritable Air Delivery Systems</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233279":false,"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><b><span data-contrast="auto">​</span></b><b><span data-contrast="auto">Capability 2:</span></b><b><span data-contrast="none"> </span></b><span data-contrast="auto">Autonomous, Attritable Surface Vessels Capable of Transporting 1-4 TEUs</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233279":false,"134245417":false,"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><b><span data-contrast="auto">​</span></b><b><span data-contrast="auto">Capability 3:</span></b><span data-contrast="auto"> Autonomous Ground Delivery Systems for Logistics and Resupply Operations </span></span> <span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span style="font-size: 16px" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></li>
</ul>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">For detailed topic descriptions, see Appendix A of the RFI. </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="auto">​</span><span data-contrast="auto">Capabilities submitted for evaluation </span><b><span data-contrast="auto">shall meet</span></b><span data-contrast="auto"> the following criteria, as applicable: </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p>
<ul>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">TRL 6 or higher;</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">Clear linkages to resolving the problem statement and meeting the desired characteristics for the capability gap in which technology will compete;</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">Demonstrate viability to field solutions within 180 days of contract award;</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">Technical interoperability with Global Command & Control System-Army (GCCS-A) for situational awareness (SA), force tracking, and system tasking; Global Combat Support System-Army (GCSS-A) for tactical logistics; as current Army systems are replaced, the system will need to support data flows for future SA, force tracking, and system tasking capabilities;</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">Modular in nature (hardware) and utilize open architecture (software) that facilitates ‘plug and play’ interoperability with existing sensors and communications architectures most commonly utilized by the U.S. and multi-national partners;</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">Capable of operating in a denied, degraded, intermittent and limited GPS and communications environment; </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">Demonstrate cyber resilience and compliance;</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">Demonstrate assured control in contested environments; </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">Provide safe, predictable behavior around personnel and other unmanned systems, including failsafe mechanisms, obstacle detection / avoidance, and emergency stop behaviors in all modes of operation (remote, tele-operated, autonomous, etc.); and</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
<li><span aria-label="Rich text content control paragraph"><span data-contrast="none">​</span><span data-contrast="none">Provide on-board diagnostics with operator notification of degraded state (software or sensor failure).</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></li>
</ul>
</p>

			<h2>FILTER GLOSSARY</h2>
<hr />
<p><strong>PROGRAMS</strong></p>
<p><strong>ASA(ALT)</strong></p>
<p>Assistant Secretary of the Army for Acquisition, Logistics, and Technology ASA(ALT) releases contract opportunities on an ad-hoc basis to meet Army research and development needs.</p>
<p><strong>AFC</strong></p>
<p>Army Futures Command (AFC) releases topics during three specific solicitation periods throughout the fiscal year to address the Army’s current and anticipated war-fighting technology needs.</p>
<p><strong>Army STTR</strong></p>
<p>Army STTR follows AFC’s topic release schedule but partners with a university, federally funded research and development center, or a qualified non-profit research institution as part of their contract.</p>
<p><strong>PHASES</strong></p>
<p><strong>Phase I</strong></p>
<p>Is the opportunity to establish the scientific, technical, commercial merit and feasibility of your proposed innovation.</p>
<p><strong>Phase II</strong></p>
<p>Is focused on the development, demonstration and delivery of your innovation from Phase I.</p>
<p><strong>Phase III</strong></p>
<p>Represents the commercialization phase of the program in which the company can market their products or services developed in Phase II, either to the government or in the commercial sector.</p>
<p><strong>Direct to Phase II</strong></p>
<p>Allows small businesses to submit to Direct to Phase II applications if they performed the Phase I research through other funding sources.</p>
<p><strong>Phase II Enhancement</strong></p>
<p>Provides funding to projects that require additional funding during their open Phase II contract.</p>
<p><strong>Phase II Sequential</strong></p>
<p>A Phase II Awardee may receive one additional, sequential Phase II award to continue the work of an initial Phase II award. The sequential Phase II award has the same guideline amounts and limits as an initial Phase II award.</p>
<p><strong>TECHNOLOGY ECOSYSTEMS</strong></p>
<p>Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (supply chain management, logistics coordination, target identifications and simulation)</p>
<p>Advanced Materials and Manufacturing (additive manufacturing)</p>
<p>Autonomy (unmanned systems, drones, ground vehicle capabilities)</p>
<p>Chemical and Biological (detection, defense)</p>
<p>Cyber (biometric authentication, secure communications)</p>
<p>Electronics (microelectronics, Very-Large-Scale Integration (VLSI))</p>
<p>Electronic Warfare (jamming, spoofing)</p>
<p>Human Performance (wearables)</p>
<p>Immersive (augmented reality, virtual reality, mixed reality)</p>
<p>Network Technologies (antennas, radio frequency, communications systems)</p>
<p>Position, Navigation, and Timing (GPS)</p>
<p>Power (batteries, generators)</p>
<p>Software Modernization (high performance computing, data management and visualization)</p>
<p>Sensors (infrared sensing)</p>
<p>Weapons Systems (hypersonics, munitions and projectiles, directed energy)</p>
